Mod.Name: Ragnarok Rebalancing Mod
Mod.Author: Callisto
Mod.Description:
Rebalances the core gameplay to deliver a fresh, engaging challenge for veterans and newcomers alike. This mod scales up enemy difficulty and balances Triple Triad rewards, while injecting major quality-of-life upgrades like a lifted Draw cap, extra save points, and starting spells.
From version 2.0 onwards, offers an overhauled combat system with several new features:
• Enhanced character weapons featuring unique passive abilities, multi-stat boosts, and more effects on Limit Breaks. • High-impact Guardian Forces made genuinely worth summoning in battle, balanced by a strict limit of one summon per GF per battle. • Strategic tactical cooldowns applied to character Limit Breaks after activation. • Unique equipment perks and bonus effects attached to every single GF. • Expanded character customisation with a suite of new Character and Command Abilities to unlock. • An accessible new Casual difficulty option alongside the more brutal Standard and Lionhard modes.
Whether you want to recapture the feel of your very first playthrough or test your tactical limits, feel free to give this mod a go. To share impressions or report bugs, please use the Qhimm forum or Discord!
